provenance.manuscript_version_note: The existing Know Place blueprint cites a differently titled EGUsphere preprint (DOI 10.5194/egusphere-2026-5462). The relationship between the EGUsphere and supplied Research Square records has not been formally verified. All IDs and scalar values in this manifest are transcribed only from the user-supplied Research Square PDF and its supplement; do not silently merge records.

live_author_catalog_check.caution: A live catalog NOT_FOUND result is not proof the author's archived file does not exist. The separate historical catalog gate reports X05026 for the first pair; do not substitute it silently.

spatial_definition.polygon_source: Main paper Methods, bulk referencing; Supplementary Figure 2 caption
spatial_definition.site_series_geometry_policy: One crown-local radar geometry is used throughout the site series; the paper does not document an explicit HAE/datum query in the text.
spatial_definition.footprint_geometry_policy: Per-pixel radar geometry interpolated at Copernicus DEM GLO-90 elevation on the common GOFF grid.

raster_and_selection_policy.los_sign_convention: LOS unit vector is target-to-sensor; positive slant-range offset means motion away from sensor; vertical motion is set to zero for the horizontal projection.
raster_and_selection_policy.bulk_reference: Component-wise median over SNR-valid pixels within the 6 km box but outside the crown; no further stability selection.
raster_and_selection_policy.site_directional_coherence: 5x5 mean resultant length R of unit displacement vectors. Published estimator crops the crown and reflects at crop edges; author code is needed to pin missing-neighbour behaviour exactly.
raster_and_selection_policy.polygon_null: Random compact regions with crown valid-pixel count on valid ground within the 6 km box; 857-996 accepted draws depending on pair. The published text does not fully specify PRNG/draw implementation.

gamma_crosscheck_co_event.comparability: Only the sign of crown-minus-box is comparable with geocoded/referenced NISAR statistics.

interpretation.paper_conclusion: Pre-failure motion is measurable, but the source is not distinctive against the calibrated population; no pre-event interval clears the 95th percentile for displacement or directional coherence, and no acceleration is resolved.
interpretation.source_variant_mismatch: Supplementary Table 1 lists P05023 for the first pair, but the historical raw replay used X05026. Live ASF identity lookup confirmed four author IDs and returned NOT_FOUND for the exact first P05023 ID; preserve historical X05026 only as historical evidence. Raw-data hashes for the exact first P05023 file are unavailable.
interpretation.next_gate: Download/hash the Zenodo archive at the DOI above, verify all author code/data files, validate exact P05023 first-pair identity in ASF, then perform pixelwise and all-five-pair golden comparison.
